title: Employees
intro: Maintain employee records and the organizational structure: departments and positions.

sections.title: Employee list
steps: Add or edit employees with role, department, and contact details.
Employee records feed attendance, leave, and payroll tabs.
sections.caption: Employees tab.

sections.title: Departments
sections.intro: Departments group staff for reporting and cost allocation.
steps: Create departments that match how the venue organizes teams.
Assign employees to departments on their employee form.
sections.caption: Departments tab.

sections.title: Positions
steps: Define job titles used on employee records and schedules.
Keep positions aligned with pay profiles when payroll is enabled.
sections.caption: Positions tab.

sections.title: Employee form
sections.intro: Core HR record linking POS user, org structure, and employment dates.
steps: From Employees tab click Add or edit a row.
Complete employee number, name, and employment details.
Link POS user, department, position, cost center, and manager.
Save — record feeds attendance, leave, and payroll.
sections.caption: Employee create/edit modal.

fields.name: Employee number
fields.effect: Unique staff identifier on schedules and exports.

fields.name: First / last name
fields.effect: Legal or preferred name on HR documents.

fields.name: Linked user
fields.effect: Optional POS login tied to this employee for clock-in.

fields.name: Position
fields.effect: Job title used on schedules and pay rules.

fields.name: Employment status
fields.effect: Active, inactive, terminated, on leave, or suspended.

fields.name: Employment type
fields.effect: Hourly, salary, contract, etc. — aligns with pay profiles.

fields.name: Hire / termination date
fields.effect: Service dates for tenure and eligibility.

sections.title: Department form
steps: From Departments or inline Add on employee form.
Save — department appears on employees and positions.
sections.caption: Department form.

fields.name: Is active
fields.effect: Inactive departments are hidden from new assignments.

sections.title: Position form
steps: From Positions or inline Add on employee form.
Define code, name, department, and default cost center.
Save — position is selectable on employees and schedules.
sections.caption: Position form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Job title shown in HR and scheduling.

fields.name: Department
fields.effect: Default org unit for this role.

fields.name: Default cost center
fields.effect: Pre-filled on schedules for this position.

fields.name: Is active
fields.effect: Retire titles no longer hired against.
